facts.development: International expert consensus using a modified Delphi process

relevant_items.paraphrase: Describe preprocessing methods transparently and use them appropriately
State the settings used to extract features
Evaluate against an approach without radiomics or demonstrate added clinical value

studies.permitted_claim: Attention to processing details, comparator models, partitioning and code availability is consistent with topics covered by METRICS
studies.limits: No METRICS score or quality category has been calculated for this project. Citing the framework does not establish compliance, clinical usefulness, standardized-software benchmarking, or independent reproducibility. DOI contains 2023 but publication year is 2024.

own_study_claims.claim: Eight fixed MRI descriptors from FLAIR and postcontrast T1 are concatenated with five clinical inputs for a fixed L2-regularized logistic model
Models share examinations and patient-grouped folds; fitting preprocessing uses training-fold data
Saved features, notebook code, OOF probabilities, folds and analysis locks support examination and rerunning of model evaluation
Image-based feature re-extraction additionally needs image access; model reevaluation from the feature tables does not

interpretation: Applied evaluation in medical image computing: implementation and matched incremental assessment, without a claim of a new learning algorithm
access_and_reproducibility_limits: Only 18 source images are in the repository; 528 additional images were archived separately, with holder-account access for the stored archive and public source URLs documented as an acquisition alternative
No claim that all source images are publicly hosted in the project repository or that future source availability is guaranteed
Historical notebooks executed through an in-process kernel; browser frontend and separate kernel server were not tested
Independent reproduction and external validation are not newly performed in this writing stage
